## Checklist: what to check when the transcript arrives (internal)

Read the transcript against the judicial affidavit (Exhibit K) and the 14 October cross and re-direct notes. Mark each item: as intended / different / missing.

| # | Point | What the transcript should show |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Corrections to the affidavit stated on direct | Purposes (g)-(h) date read as 29 September 2016 (not "September 26, 2019"); Q11-Q12 area read as 28,891 sq m (not 28,981). If not stated, a written errata is needed before the formal offer. |
| 2 | Q25 "misappropriated"; Q26 "directly informed Cesar"; Q26 "a new Special Power of Attorney"; "negotiate only" (purpose [e], Q18, Q25, Q53) | Whether any was softened or corrected on direct, and in what words. |
| 3 | Exhibits identified | A to J identified; whether the partition entry on Exhibit B (Entry 2021003236) was sub-marked B-5; any exhibit objected to, and the ruling. |
| 4 | Authority to testify for the plaintiff | Which SPA was identified, and its exhibit letter. |
| 5 | Cross: personal knowledge | The exact questions and answers on events before 2025, and anything conceded about what he learned from documents or from his mother. |
| 6 | Cross: the SPA, the class and consultation | Any answer about paragraph 7, the 1996 annotation, the revocation date (15 August 2005), the 2020 publication, and the 1980s down payment. |
| 7 | Cross: dates | "Late 2022" as when he learned of the sale, if asked; registration date 23 November 2021. |
| 8 | Anything outside the exhibits | Any fact stated without an exhibit, any opinion on another person's knowledge or intent, any characterization of a party. List each with the page. |
| 9 | Re-direct | Questions asked and answers; anything left open for recall. |
| 10 | Rulings and orders from the bench | Any statement by the court on the case, the exhibits, Patricia, the witness order or the next settings. |

Anything marked "different" or "missing" goes to counsel with the transcript page, and the strategy documents are corrected to the transcript, not to memory.
